title: United against food waste
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
At which stage is food waste most unacceptable: farms, supermarkets, restaurants, or homes?
Why do people throw away food that is still safe to eat?
Should supermarkets be allowed to reject fruit and vegetables only because they look imperfect?
Would you use an app that offered near-expiry food at a large discount?
What one change could your household make to waste less food this week?
